capabilities: Posts the whole note or the selected text to connected social networks
Opens a prefilled post window for editing before publishing
Reports per-network delivery status with a link to each post
Saves the API key and last-ticked networks in the plugin data.json
extras: Text-only: image/video-only networks appear greyed out; no scheduling. Free plan limits one post to 2 networks. API key and last-used networks are stored in the vault's data.json, so syncing or sharing the vault exposes them; plugin sends no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a note or a text selection to social networks without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Create a free account at postwire.io and connect your social accounts there.

requires.name: PostWire paid plan (more than 2 networks per post)

summary: PostWire integration that posts the current note or selected text to social media accounts.
